_: Proposed answers for SoM V2, written from what the repository already knows. The studio shows each as a proposal to accept or change; nothing here is an answer until it is saved in the studio.

proposed.q01: Stone of Matter, Book I, by B. L. Barkey (Wolf Den Publishing, 2019), my own novel, and my Episode 2 screenplay, Darkness (LoL Movie Night draft). Both are already stored in the codex (codex/_source on the claude/codex branch). The rights are mine.
proposed.q02: The Episode 2 screenplay: 15 scenes, 36 pages. In the novel: Chapter IV (Cloud Mountain, the bridge from Episode 1) and Chapters VII–XI (High Forest, Wind Caves, Song of Stardust, Lake of Light, Dark Energy).
proposed.q03: A light being seeds a young world against the dark, and thousands of years later a boy who can hear the wind learns that the dark has four of the seven stones and is coming for the fifth.
proposed.q04: Ammon. S25: the lantern raised to his face in the elevator.
proposed.q09: I Stardust: white on black with a violet edge. II High Forest: lantern amber on green-black. III Lake of Light: blue-green light in the water under a silver moon. IV The Leviticum: candle gold against violet-black; the dream in storm violet and emerald; the Outer Darkness lit only by the Stone.
proposed.q10: Cue A, the prologue: Seeds of Darkness. Cue B, the High Forest to the Lake: Every Light Casts a Shadow, with We Are One at the Wind Caves. Cue C, the Leviticum to the end: Conqueror, then Before They Follow. Tracks to assign.
proposed.q11: Generated voices per line as in Episode 1, four takes each, attached as audio references. Speaking shots: S4, S6, S11–S13, S16, S17, S22–S25.
proposed.q12: Souls: Ammon and Sadie. Elements only: Mikael, Krystal, Bastion, Viola, Vothek, Master Lyon, Matteo, Venetia (woman and panther on one sheet), Morningstar, Lucille; Stardust as a glass figure.
proposed.q13: Places and plates: courtyard-of-worlds, plate-sun, machira-orbit, plate-ocean-dark, plate-island, corals-abyss. Effects: fx-kill-beat, fx-hollow. No faces recur.
proposed.q14: Proposal: about 150 credits for the 35 sheets and the anchor stills (a still is about 1.5), then about 560 for a first 8-second pass of the ten set-piece shots (about 56 each). Hold the rest until Gate B.
proposed.q16: Gate A, identity lock: every new face and place sheeted and turned into an element, Souls for Ammon and Sadie trained, all on one screen with nothing drifting. By:
